text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Hourly output as a percentage of capacity, measured and as forecast out of fold by the XGBoost model given the ENS ensemble mean at day 1 and at day 7, averaged over its three fitting seeds. Gaps are hours outside the scored rows. The week is chosen by rule from measured output alone: the week whose daily mean output varies most from day to day. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output.'
text.tspan: Hourly output as a percentage of capacity, measured and as forecast out of fold by the XGBoost model given the ENS
ensemble mean at day 1 and at day 7, averaged over its three fitting seeds. Gaps are hours outside the scored rows.
The week is chosen by rule from measured output alone: the week whose daily mean output varies most from day to
day. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output.
